info.title: Web Scraper Cloud API
info.description: API allows to manage sitemaps, scraping jobs and download data.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of sitemaps for the authenticated user's organization.

post.description: Imports a sitemap from raw JSON content and creates a new sitemap.

get.description: Returns details for a single sitemap by ID.

put.description: Updates sitemap JSON for an existing sitemap.
Renames a sitemap and updates related scraping job sitemap names.

get.description: Returns scheduler configuration for a sitemap.

post.description: Enables sitemap scheduler with the provided cron and execution settings.

get.description: Returns tags assigned to a sitemap.

post.description: Adds a tag to a sitemap.

delete.description: Removes a tag from a sitemap.

post.description: Creates a new scraping job for a sitemap.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of scraping jobs for the authenticated user's organization.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter jobs by status. Omit to return jobs of all statuses.

get.description: Returns details for a single scraping job by ID
Returns a paginated list of problematic URLs for the scraping job.
Streams scraping job data as a downloadable file.

parameters.name: raw
parameters.description: Return raw exported data format when set to `true`.

Content-Type.description: MIME type based on selected extension.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename for the downloaded export file.

schema.description: Streamed NDJSON/JSONL export where each line is a JSON object.

get.description: Returns data quality statistics for a scraping job.

post.description: Continues a stopped or pausable scraping job. All parameters are optional. Any parameter that is not provided keeps the scraping job's current value.
Stops a running or pausable scraping job.

get.description: Returns account details for the authenticated user.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token passed in the Authorization header.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed in the current rate limit window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp when the current rate limit window resets.

tags.name: Sitemaps
tags.description: Endpoints for importing and managing sitemaps.

tags.name: Scraping jobs
tags.description: Endpoints for creating and managing scraping jobs.
